> 第二十四章 实验事故（第1页）
以塞恩的中级学徒水准，参与到摩西多导师这样的正式黑魔法师的实验中，还是有些太过勉强了。
好在塞恩之前有认真研读摩西多导师赠予的《炼金术入门讲解。
哪怕不知道导师这项实验的具体原理是什么，但在实验过程中，通过观察一些边边角角的东西，以及留心注意导师实验过程中的细节，也足以让塞恩受益匪浅。
这也是塞恩作为摩西多的五弟子，才能有的福利和好处。
不然黑魔法学院比塞恩实力更强，又或者是脑子比他聪慧的学徒多了去了。
他们必然也想近距离观察一位正式黑魔法师的实验过程，并希望体会炼金术的奥义。
但可惜，师门的限制，以及魔法师们对知识的重视程度，让摩西多根本不可能把自己宝贵的知识随意散播出去。
譬如公共课堂上，摩西多大师教授的《炼金术入门讲解和《火元素基础知识，恐怕让那些魔法学徒们想破脑袋，也不会料到还有那么多隐晦且未在书面上涉及到的空白知识。
只有塞恩成为摩西多大师的弟子，并获得了他的真传魔法笔记，才能真正登堂入室，得以钻研魔法的奥妙。
类似摩西多导师这样的黑魔法师，绝对不止是个例。
魔索布拉城黑魔法学院的正式黑魔法师们，几乎个个都留着一手。
公共课堂只是按照院长的要求，义务教给这些小家伙们入门知识罢了。
魔法学徒们要想走得更远，探索更加真理奥义知识，只能拜这些性格桀骜且孤僻的黑魔法师，才有机会一窥究竟。
塞恩前后在这处实验室里协助导师等人进行了大半个月的实验。
虽然这项实验从始至终跟塞恩没多大关系，他只是一个忠实的实验数据记录者。
包括他的活动范围，也仅限于那个小实验台周围五米而已。
但这半个多月的实验过程，却是让塞恩感到由衷的受益匪浅。
书本上得来的知识，终究只是死物。

要想真正融会贯通，还得亲自上手操作才行。
师姐菲儿不知道是对炼金术不感兴趣，还是单纯的想偷懒，在实验进行到后半段时，她几乎就把小实验台上的一切操作步骤都交给了塞恩。
好在这些操作步骤都很简单，又或者是塞恩真的有炼金术方面的天赋。
虽然一开始表现的磕磕绊绊，但大半个月后，终于流畅了许多。
一块拳头大小的绯红色圆球，是摩西多导师和他三个弟子，近半个多月以来的最终收获。
据师姐菲儿私下跟塞恩交流，为了这个火元素裂变发生器，他们已经前后忙了近三个月时间。
早在塞恩拜师之前，摩西多导师就和大师兄有过深入讨论。
继火元素裂变发生器之后，导师摩西多接下来还需要做水元素裂变发生器、土元素裂变发生器以及风元素裂变发生器。
有火元素裂变发生器成功在前，后三者的制作过程应该会顺畅许多。
塞恩也是这么想的，直到水元素裂变发生器的制作，刚刚来到第三天。
“轰隆！”一阵巨大的魔法爆炸声出现在摩西多导师的房子外。
不仅实验室里的塞恩等人被搞得有些灰头土脸，就连他们昨天放入实验台的那枚水系璀璨晶石，也在一阵轰鸣声中，碎裂成两半。
浓郁的水之元素，充斥在这间实验室里。
浸湿了实验室里的大半实验器材，就连处于实验台最中心的摩西多导师，猝不及防之下也被溅射出的水元素能量击退了数米有余。
作为正式魔法师，这点意外和元素冲击不算什么。

> Chapter 24 Experimental Accident (Page 1)
With Thane's intermediate apprentice level, it was still a bit too reluctant to participate in the experiments of a formal black magician like Mentor Moses.
Fortunately, Thain had carefully studied the "Introduction to Alchemy" given by Teacher Moses.
Even if he didn't know the specific principle of his mentor's experiment, during the experiment, by observing some corner things and paying attention to the details of his mentor's experiment, Thain benefited a lot.
This is also the benefit that Thane can only have as the fifth disciple of Moses.
Otherwise, the Black Magic Academy is stronger than Thane, or there are more apprentices with smarter brains than him.
They must also want to observe the experimental process of an official black magician up close, and hope to understand the mysteries of alchemy.
But unfortunately, the restrictions of the division and the importance that magicians place on knowledge make it impossible for Moses to spread his precious knowledge at will.
For example, in the public classroom, the "Introduction to Alchemy" and "Basic Knowledge of the Fire Element" taught by Master Mosheduo probably made those magic apprentices scratch their heads, and they did not expect that there were so many obscure and blank knowledge that were not covered in writing.
Only when Thain becomes a disciple of Master Moses and obtains his true magic notes can he truly enter the palace and delve into the mysteries of magic.
Black magicians like Master Moses are definitely not just an exception.
Almost all of the official black magicians at the Black Magic Academy in Mensobra City have a hand.
The public classroom is just a compulsory teaching of introductory knowledge to these little guys in accordance with the requirements of the dean.
If magic apprentices want to go further and explore more truthful and profound knowledge, they can only have a chance to get a glimpse of it by worshiping these unruly and lonely black magicians.
Thain assisted his mentor and others in conducting experiments in this laboratory for more than half a month.
Although this experiment had little to do with Thain from beginning to end, he was just a faithful recorder of experimental data.
Including his range of activities, it is limited to five meters around the small experimental platform.
But the experimental process of more than half a month made Thain feel sincerely benefited a lot.
The knowledge gained from books is, after all, just a dead thing.
If you want to truly understand it, you have to do it yourself.
Senior sister Fei'er didn't know whether it was because she wasn't interested in alchemy or just wanted to be lazy. In the second half of the experiment, she handed almost all the operating steps on the small experimental table to Thain.
Fortunately, these steps are very simple, or maybe Thain really has a talent for alchemy.
Although the performance was stumbling at first, after half a month, it finally became much smoother.
A crimson ball the size of a fist was the final harvest of Master Moses and his three disciples in the past half a month.
According to senior sister Fei'er's private communication with Thain, they have been busy for nearly three months for this fire element fission generator.
Long before Thain became a disciple, Instructor Moses had had in-depth discussions with his senior brother.
After the fire element fission generator, instructor Mosheduo also needs to make a water element fission generator, an earth element fission generator, and a wind element fission generator.
With the success of the fire element fission generator, the production process of the latter three should be much smoother.
Thain thought the same way until the third day of making the water element fission generator.
"Boom!" A huge magical explosion appeared outside the house of Master Moshe.
Not only did Thain and others in the laboratory feel a little disgraceful, but even the brilliant water-based crystal they put into the experimental table yesterday shattered into pieces amid a roar.Split in half.
The rich water element filled this laboratory.
Most of the experimental equipment in the laboratory was soaked, and even Instructor Moses, who was at the center of the experimental platform, was caught off guard and knocked back several meters by the splashed water element energy.
As a formal magician, this accident and elemental impact are nothing.
